name: Qur'anic recitation (tilawa) and the call to prayer

definition.sound: Unaccompanied melodic recitation of the Qur'an under the rules of tajwid, from the slow, ornate mujawwad style to the plainer murattal; the adhan calls the faithful to prayer.
markers: Long held vowels and nasal resonance set by tajwid
Phrases shaped in maqam, separated by long pauses
